(define center (grid/card-center '#card/main/status))
(if center
  (display (list "Card center:" center))
  (display "Card not found"))

(define (spawn-effect-at-card card-id)
  (let ((center (grid/card-center card-id)))
    (if center
      (world/spawn 'effect (car center) (cadr center) '())
      (escalate 'card-not-found card-id))))
(spawn-effect-at-card '#card/main/boss)
The card ID must include the full prefix (e.g., '#card/main/...' or '#card/...')—stripping is done internally.

(define (swarm-to-card flower-ids card-id)
  (for-each (lambda (fid)
    (grid/flower-go-to! fid card-id))
    flower-ids))
(swarm-to-card '(f1 f2 f3) '#card/gallery/current)

(define (follow-sequence cards)
  (define (step remaining)
    (if (null? remaining) #t
      (let ((card (car remaining)))
        (grid/flower-go-to! 'leader card)
        (after 2000 (lambda () (step (cdr remaining)))))))
  (step cards))
(follow-sequence '(#card/a #card/b #card/c))
